visual_action: A montage of clips shows Kamala Harris at various campaign events. She waves to crowds from a stage with a large American flag, claps and laughs alongside Joe Biden, interacts with supporters in crowds, hugs a young girl, and speaks to a studio audience on a set with a "NOTICIAS Univision" logo. Supporters are shown cheering and holding up campaign signs, including one that says "KAMALA" in large letters.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris is the central figure in every clip of the montage.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Appears briefly in one clip, clapping and smiling next to Kamala Harris.

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: His name appears on a campaign sign alongside Harris's, though the clip is brief and blurry.

cast.name: Univision
cast.evidence: The logo "NOTICIAS Univision" is visible on the set in one of the clips.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. An upbeat pop song with female vocals plays throughout the video.
audio_music: An upbeat, energetic pop-rock song with female vocals plays throughout, creating a celebratory and motivational tone. The lyrics include the phrase "on the edge of glory" and the music sounds like Lady Gaga's "The Edge of Glory".
editing_pacing: A fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various clips.
cultural_references: Lady Gaga (musician, via the song 'The Edge of Glory')
central_claim: On Election Day, Kamala Harris is presented as a popular and energetic candidate who is generating excitement among her supporters.
intended_effect: To energize supporters and create a sense of celebration and urgency around voting on Election Day.
uncertainty_flags: The presence of Tim Walz's face, as indicated by authoritative face-ID, could not be visually confirmed in the fast-paced montage, though his name appears on a campaign sign.
